name: EONA
detailed_description:
Eona :

Play as Eona, a young girl cursed through both her soul and her puppet. Do your best to escape this dark castle with the Puppeteer’s Cross—a legendary artifact you stole. It is your only means of defense, and the only thing that can save your sick mother. Fail, and you will suffer the same fate as countless innocent souls before you.

Survive the evil Fairy’s Lair: 

Inside Mélusine’s domain, you are truly alone—surrounded by creaking trees and howling wind. A ruined bridge points the way toward your fate. The artifact lies behind cold stone walls. You feel eyes on you; the inhabitants know you’re here, eagerly awaiting your arrival.

Once magnificent and full of life, this place is now nothing more than a lair for the evil fairy’s creations. With a little imagination and keen observation, you can turn its secrets into your strength. Outsmart the inhabitants’ watchful eyes, climb the castle’s towering heights, explore its deepest depths—and only then might you make it out alive.

Deceive, or die : 

The mistress of the castle roams its halls, searching for what is rightfully hers—and for the poor, unfortunate soul who dared to steal it. Her servants and guards maintain the castle’s order and have been tasked with hunting down intruders.

As you see no prisoners, you begin to wonder: what fate awaits you?

Thanks to your new powers—born of your curse—disrupt life within these walls by manipulating the souls of the servants and transferring your consciousness into your puppet’s body in order to explore the castle’s many chambers.

But remember: even if your mind resides in your doll, your body remains behind… waiting for your return.

Shall you cut the threads of fate, or be reduced to a mere puppet—manipulated by occult and cruel forces?
